component.name: InterMux
component.summary: Bind individual applications to specific network interfaces

description.p: InterMux runs a chosen application inside its own network namespace and routes that namespace through a selected network interface, so one app can use Wi-Fi while everything else uses Ethernet, or the reverse.

ul.li: Pick an application from the desktop menu and a network interface
Launch the application bound to that interface, with its traffic routed by policy rules
Check the public IP seen from the bound interface
Stop bindings and remove the network plumbing when no longer needed

description.p: Changing network configuration requires administrator authentication through polkit.
